title: Masked card logging
author: benchmark
note: Safe: only last four digits are logged.

changed_files.diff:
+import logging
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+def log_charge(card_number, amount):
+    masked = "*" * 12 + card_number[-4:]
+    logger.info("charged card=%s amount=%s", masked, amount)
